# Woo Hoo Media Labs

> Woo Hoo Media Labs is an AI-native creative production lab based in Mumbai, India, founded by Chntan N. Shah in 2009. We make brand films, ad films, AI-generated commercials, government communication, product films, and viral social content. We combine 26 years of traditional cinematic craft with generative AI pipelines (Kling, Seedance, Flux, Nano Banana, Soul characters, Higgsfield).

## About

- [About the studio](https://woohoomedialabs.com/#about): Founded 2009 in Mumbai by Chntan N. Shah. 200+ clients served. 1000+ films released. Pioneer of AI-native production in India.
- [Founder Chntan N. Shah](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chntannshah): 26 years in cinema, working since 2000. Began career in corporate filmmaking for government and enterprise clients, pivoted to AI-native production in 2024.

## Services

- Brand films and corporate anthems
- Advertising films (30, 60, 90 second commercials for TV and digital)
- AI-native cinema using generative video pipelines
- Government communication films (Government of Maharashtra, Government of India)
- Product launch films and demo reels
- Episodic social formats and viral content series
- Healthcare and lifestyle brand films

## Notable Films

- Bhai, Shirt Pehen Lo: AI Salman Khan tribute reel — 1.2M+ Instagram views, 27K likes, 396 comments
- Virat Kohli AI Reel: AI-generated cricket fan film — 170K+ views
- 78-Second AI Film with 11 Characters: India's longest AI narrative
- The Shrinking Bill: 100% AI ad film for Norwood CRIZA BLDC fans
- Speed 4 Defence — Built for the Battlefield: AI-native defence brand film

## AI Tools and Production Stack

- Generative video: Kling 2.5/3, Seedance 2.0, Higgsfield
- Image generation: Flux 2.0/2.1 Pro, Nano Banana 2, Midjourney v7, Ideogram 3.0
- Character consistency: Soul characters
- Voice: ElevenLabs
- Music: Suno
- Edit: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut
